objective: Instantiate an adjacent KEDDEH-controlled edge runtime aligned to IL-LLM semantic derivation and BRAINK/KEX route-lineage without rewriting the existing virtual mesh kernel.
design_decisions: Do not alter existing virtual mesh kernel unless a regression proves a dependency.
Edge is derived as semantic closure of ingress, TLS, routing, listener resolution, domain space, server runtime and recovery.
Finite physical ingress is distinct from logical listener/service cardinality.
External carriers and registrars never enter KEX lineage.
Digests are integrity evidence only and never KEX authority.
Public promotion fails closed unless every required gate carries EXTERNAL OBSERVED evidence.
Historical Sites DNS values are lineage evidence, not current write authority.

local_test_history.finding: IL-LLM compiler correctly rejected DOMAIN_SPACE -> listener resolver because service.coordinate was not explicitly admitted by the derived listener contract.
local_test_history.resolution: Expanded the derived KEX_EDGE_LISTENER_RESOLVER interface to accept service.coordinate and preserved strict validation.

local_test_history.finding: Loopback test used fetch Host-header semantics that did not exercise the requested authority value reliably.
local_test_history.resolution: Replaced fetch test with node:http request using an explicit Host header; no production resolver weakening.

local_test_history.finding: Final package passes semantic, deterministic, routing, rejection, ledger, rehydration, durable receipt and native TLS/SNI fixture tests.

claim_boundary: The adjacent code is executable and locally tested. GitHub publication records source lineage only. No claim is made that keddeh.com, its subdomains, public DNS, trusted TLS, WAN ingress or a remote KEDDEH edge node are currently live.

source_publication.rule: GitHub source publication is read back separately from local execution. Blob/commit identity is not substituted for the local execution receipt or KEX proof authority.
